text: 兽人沿山坡谨慎逼近。它们直立行走，肌肉发达、头顶有猿类冠毛，虽像猿却也像人。它们靠近时，你开始咳嗽；那气味令人窒息。
多年的训练让你想到一些安抚大脚怪的技巧。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 626
text: The beast-men advance down the slopes, wary. They are fully upright, human-like despite their muscular bulk and apish crests. When they get close, you start to cough. Their stench is overwhelming.
Your years of training suggest techniques to pacify and mollify the sasquatches.
